definitions.explanation: A train service faster than a regular express. Originally referred to the first Shinkansen services.

definitions.gloss: at top speed; in a huge rush; extremely fast
definitions.explanation: Used figuratively to describe doing something at maximum speed or completing a task in an extremely short time.

examples.japanese: {超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}で⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: I headed to Tokyo on the super express.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新幹線|しんかんせん}→新幹線：01053_shinkansen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{開業|かいぎょう}→開業：14570_kaigyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Shinkansen was launched as a super express service.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦{停車|ていしゃ}→停車：04534_teisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: This train is a super express, so it makes few intermediate stops.

examples.japanese: {超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}げて→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please finish it at top speed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{近|ちか}い→近い：00530_chikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}で⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The deadline was close, so I worked at top speed.

examples.japanese: {超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{企画書|きかくしょ}→企画書：20593_kikakusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: I put together the proposal at breakneck speed, so I'm still uneasy about the content.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{超|ちょう}→超〜：28619_chou⟧ (super, ultra) + ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧ (limited express). Originally a railway term for trains faster than ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧, notably the first Shinkansen in 1964. Now commonly used figuratively to mean doing something extremely fast.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}で⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧: to finish at top speed
- {超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}で⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to respond at maximum speed
- {超特急|ちょうとっきゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧: to deliver at top speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧: limited express — the standard fast train service; also used figuratively but with less intensity
- ⟦{急行|きゅうこう}→急行：01386_kyuukou⟧: express — slower than ⟦{特急|とっきゅう}→特急：01476_tokkyuu⟧
- {大至急|だいしきゅう}: extremely urgent — similar figurative meaning but focused on urgency rather than speed
